description: Remove chunks players barely visited so they regenerate on the next visit and the disk is freed. Spawn and player positions are always protected and a backup of the changed files is kept. The server must be stopped. Defaults to a dry run that only reports what would happen; pass dry_run=false to prune for real.

dry_run.description: true (default) previews without changing anything; false prunes.

threshold.description: Which chunks to remove: never_visited (safest), under_1_min, or under_5_min of player presence.

name: prune_world
title: Prune World
